summary: INNEOVA Holdings Limited, a Singapore-based foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, furnished a Form 6-K on October 14, 2026, releasing unaudited interim condensed financial statements and supplemental financial information for the six months ended June 30, 2026. Revenue fell 16.2% to $25.8 million from $30.8 million, operating income slipped to $0.7 million from $1.1 million, and net income rose to $0.3 million, or $0.02 per share, on 16.17 million shares. This is a routine periodic earnings disclosure, not a special situation; no transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is involved.
